description: Dependabot covers GitHub Actions, devcontainer feature refs and base images. Renovate only tracks tool versions that Dependabot cannot see: ARGs in Dockerfiles and feature version options in images/*/devcontainer.json, each marked with a '# renovate:' or '// renovate:' comment.

customManagers.description: Tool versions annotated in Dockerfiles (ARG NAME=value)
Feature version options annotated in images/*/devcontainer.json

packageRules.description: Keep each tool in its own PR so a failing smoke test points at one change
Copilot CLI and Claude Code release often; batch them into one weekly PR
